# Brand images

`readme.svg`, `social.svg` and `og.svg` are the sources for `readme.png` (README hero, 2560x1280), `social.png` (GitHub social preview, 1280x640) and `../../public/og.png` (`og:image` and `twitter:image`, 1200x630), as listed in `brand.config.json`; render them with `npm run brand:images` (`node .github/brand/render.mjs`), and `npm run brand:images:check` (`--check`) re-renders in memory and exits 1 if any source or output is stale. The fonts are Catamaran, Cabin and Roboto Mono under the SIL OFL 1.1 (license texts in `fonts/`), vendored with `render.mjs`, `embed-fonts.mjs` and `tokens.json` from the marcopontili.com repo-brand kit, so do not edit those kit files here. The social preview is uploaded manually in GitHub Settings > Social preview from `social.png`.
